rows.grounds: fused form taravaḥ + api; trees included by emphatic particle
demonstrative referring to the named beings
predicate affirming life of the individual being

items.question: What range of beings, including trees and animals, possesses life?
premises: A beast is a living being.
A bird is a living being.
items.inference: Life extends across diverse beings, from trees to animals and birds.
uncertainties: The scope of sa is ambiguous; it may refer distributively to each named being or collectively.
items.plain_english: Even trees indeed live; a beast and a bird also live.
